_comment: Human review decisions, applied on every pipeline run. One entry per reviewed item: {"review_item_uid": "concept:...", "review_decision": "ACCEPT" | "REJECT" | "RENAME", "new_name": "(RENAME only)", "reviewer": "name", "decided_at": "YYYY-MM-DD", "notes": "..."}. Empty until a person reviews the queue -- the pipeline never fabricates approval.
